answer: Parking 75 POA per mask means a farm of 497 masks must set aside 37275 POA before the epoch even opens. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Saddle gilder harness leather seal hammered at the saddle gilding shop: the toll is each harness leather is a measured saddle yield plus a guild signature, paid in the open. The workshop keeps the glacier, the ledger keeps the sonnet, time itself keeps the ledge — and none of the three works for the farm. The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo.
